questions.question: The ratio of the number of boys in sections A and B of a class is 2 : 3 and the ratio of the total number of boys and girls in sections A and B is 3 : 4. If the number of girls in B is 50% of the number of boys in B, what will be the ratio of the number of girls in A and B?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The ratio of the number of boys in sections A and B of a class = 2 : 3

The ratio of the total number of boys and girls in sections A and B = 3 : 4

The number of girls in B is 50% of the number of boys in B

**Calculation:**

Let the number of boys in section A be 2x and B be 3x respectively

⇒ Number of girls in section B = 50% of number of boys in B

⇒ 50% of 3x = 1.5x

Now,

Let the number of girls in section A be y

The ratio of the total number of boys and girls in sections A and B = 3 : 4

⇒ (2x + y)/(3x + 1.5x) = 3/4

⇒ 8x + 4y = 9x + 4.5x

⇒ 4y = 5.5x

⇒ x/y = 4/5.5

∴ Girls in section B = 1.5x = 1.5 × 4 = 6

⇒ The ratio of the number of girls in A and B = 5.5 : 6 = 11 : 12

questions.question: A can do a piece of work in 20 days and B can do it in 22 1/2 days. And both work together for 6 days and the remaining work has been completed by C in 26 days. In how many days they will complete the work, if all three work together?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A can do a piece of work in 20 days

B can do it in 22 1/2 days

Both A and B work together for 6 days

The remaining work has been completed by C in 26 days

**Concept:**

Number of days C require to complete the whole work alone should be calculated first. Then find number of days A, B, and C together require to complete the work

**Formula used:**

Number of days = Total work/1 day's work(efficiency)

**Calculation:**

A → 20

B → 22 1/2 = 45/2

Total work = LCM (20, 45/2) = 180 unit

⇒ 1 day's work of A = 180/20 = 9 unit

⇒ 1 day's work of B = 180/(45/2)= 8 unit

Both A and B work together for 6 days

And, 1 day's work of (A + B) = 9 + 8 = 17 unit

∴ Work completed by A and B in 6 days = 17 × 6 = 102 unit

⇒ Remaining work = 180 - 102 = 78 unit

The remaining work has been completed by C in 26 days

⇒ 78 unit work will be completed by C in 26 days

∴ Number of days C requires to complete the whole work(180 unit) alone = (26/78) × 180 = 60

Now,

1 day's work of C = 180/60 = 3 unit

⇒ 1 day's work of (A + B + C) = 9 + 8 + 3 = 20

∴ Number of days A, B, and C together require to complete the work = 180/20 = 9 days

questions.question: What is the present value of the amount of Rs 14739 payable in the 3 years at the rate of 6.25% compound annual interest?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Final amount = Rs.14739

Rate of interest = 6.25%

Time = 3 years

**Formula used:**

Amount = Principal [1 + (R/100)]Time

**Solution:**

Let principal be P

so, P [1 + (6.25/100)]³ = Rs.14739

⇒ P [106.25/100]³ = Rs.14739

⇒ P × (17/16)³ = Rs.14739

⇒ P = Rs.(3 × 16³)

⇒ P = Rs.12288

**∴ The present value is Rs.12288**

questions.question: Suppose x is the largest 4-digit number, divided by 7, 8 and 11 leaving 4, 5 and 8 remainder respectively. When x is divided by (7 + 8 + 11), the remainder will be:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A 4-digit number x when divided by 7, 8, and 11 leaves the remainder of 4, 5, and 8 respectively

**Solution:**

L.C.M of 7, 8, and 11 = 616

Largest 4-digit number = 9999

and 9999 = 616 × 16 + 143

and 616 × 16 = 9856

Now, difference between (7 – 4) = (8 – 5) = (11 – 8) = 3

so, Reducing 3 from 9856 = 9853

Now, when 9853 is divided by 26, then

9853 = 26 × 378 + 25

**So, The remainder will be 25**

⇒ At the end of second year, Price = 115 + (115 × (15/100)) = 132.25

questions.question: The marked price of an article was 42% more than its cost price. If there is a profit of 20.7% on selling the item, then the percentage of discount given on the marked price of the article is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The marked price of an article was 42% more than its cost price

Profit % = 20.7 %

**Concept:**

Discount is always done on Marked price

**Formula used:**

Discount % = [(M.P - S.P)/M.P] × 100

**Calculation:**

Let Cost Price, C.P be 100

⇒ M.P = 42 % More than C.P

⇒ 100 + (42/100) × 100 = 142

Profit % = 20.7 %

⇒ S.P = 100 + (20.7/100) × 100 = 120.7

∴ Discount = M.P - S.P = 142 - 120.7 = 21.3

Discount % = (21.3/142) × 100 = 15%

questions.question: The ratio of lengths of trains A and B is 5 : 3 and the ratio of their speeds is 2 : 3. Moving in the opposite direction, it took 2(1)/(2) minutes for Train A to cross B. The time (in minutes) taken by A to cross a stationary pole is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The ratio of lengths of trains A and B is 5 : 3

The ratio of their speeds is 2 : 3

Time taken to cross each other = 2(1)/(2) minutes = 5/2 minutes

**Formula used:**

Time = Distance/Speed

**Calculation:**

Let the Lengths od train A and B be 5x and 3x respectively

And Speed of A and B be 2y and 3y respectively

⇒ (5x +3x)/(2y + 3y) = 5/2

⇒ x/y = 25/16

Take x = 25 and y = 16

Now,

Length of Train A = 5x = 5 × 25 = 125

Speed of Train A = 2y = 2 × 16 = 32

∴ The time (in minutes) taken by A to cross a stationary pole = 125/32 Minutes

questions.question: If at an rate the simple interest in 3 years for Rs. 28000 is Rs. 225 more than the simple interest at the same rate in 3 years for Rs. 27000, then what will be the simple interest for Rs. 35000 at the same rate for 3 years?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

S.I for 3 years on Rs.28000 is Rs.225 more than S.I for 3 years on Rs.27000

**Formula used:**

S.I = (P × R × T)/100

**Solution:**

Let rate % be R%

so, S.I on Rs.28000 for 3 years = (28000 × R × 3)/100

⇒ 840R

And, S.I on Rs.27000 for 3 years = (27000 × R × 3)/100

⇒ 810R

Now, Difference given = Rs.225

So, 840R - 810R = 225

⇒ 30R = 225

⇒ R = 7.5%

Now, P = Rs.35000

Time = 3 Years

Rate = 7.5%

So, S.I = (35000 × 7.5 × 3)/100

⇒ Rs.7875

**∴ The S.I on Rs.35000 for 3 years is Rs.7875**

questions.question: The average of 15 numbers is 45. The average of the first six numbers is 42 and the average of the last six numbers is 43. The 7th number is double the 8th number, but 5 more than the 9th number. So, find the 7th number.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average of 15 numbers = 45

Average of first 6 numbers = 42

Average of last 6 numbers = 43

7th number is double the 8th number and 5 more than 9th number

**Concept used:**

Sum of numbers = Average × Number of numbers

**Solution:**

Total sum of 15 numbers = 15 × 45 = 675

Sum of first 6 numbers = 42
 × 6 = 252

Sum of last 6 numbers = 43 × 6 = 258

Now, Sum of first 6 numbers and last six numbers = (252 + 258) = 510

So, Sum of (7th + 8th + 9th) number = (675 - 510) = 165

Let 8th number be x

Then, 7th number = 2x 

and 9th number = 2x -5

so, (2x + x + 2x -5) = 165

⇒ 5x - 5 = 165

⇒ 5x = 170

⇒ x = 34

So, 2x = 2 × 34 = 68

**∴ The 7th number is 68.**

questions.question: A vegetable vendor bought some mangoes and sold 33(1)/(3)\% of them at 22.5% profit, 25% at 25% loss and the rest at 3% loss. Its overall profit or loss is:
questions.solution:
**Given**

33(1/3)% of mangoes are sold at 22.5% profit, 25% at 25% loss and the rest at 3% loss.

**Concept**

33(1/3)% = 1/3

**Calculation**

Let total mangoes are 12 and the cost price of each mango is 100.

Total cost price = 12 × 100 = 1200

SP of 33(1/3)% of mangoes = 4 × 122.5 = 490

SP of 25% mangoes = 3 × 75 = 225

SP of rest mangoes = 5 × 97 = 485

Total SP = 490 + 225 + 485 = 1200 

As, cost price is equal to selling price, hence there is no loss no profit.

questions.question: Sonu sold his bike at a 13.5% loss. If he had sold it for Rs 8900 more, he would have earned 31% profit. If he had sold for Rs 20740, he would have made profit or lost:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Sonu sold the bike at 13.5% loss

If S.P would have been Rs.8900 more, gain % = 31%

Final S.P = Rs.20,740

**Concept used:**

Gain % = (Gain/C.P) × 100

**Solution:**

Let C.P of bike be 100x

So, S.P = 100x × (100 – 13.5)/100 = 86.5x

And if, S.P would have been Rs.8900 more, Gain% = 31%

So, New S.P = 100x × (100 + 31)/100 = 131x

Now, New S.P – S.P = Rs.8900

⇒ 131x – 86.5x = 8900

⇒ 44.5x = Rs.8900

⇒ 100x = Rs.(8900/44.5x) × 100x

⇒ Rs.20,000

So, C.P = Rs.20,000

Final S.P = Rs.20,740

Gain = Rs.(20,740 – 20,000)

⇒ Rs.740

Gain% = (740/20,000) × 100%

⇒ 3.7%

**∴**** The profit % is 3.7% **

A : B = 4 : 3

B : C = 5 : 4

C : D = 6 : 5

**Calculation:**

A : B : C : D = 20 : 15 : 12 : 10

∴ B's share = (15/57) × 6859 = Rs.1805

questions.question: A cylindrical bucket, with a height of 27 cm and a base radius of 48 cm, is filled with sand. When the bucket is emptied to the ground and a conical pile of radius 54 cm is formed. What is the height (in cm) of the pile?
questions.solution:
**Given**

Height of cylindrical bucket = 27 cm

Radius of cylindrical bucket = 48 cm

Radius of cone = 54 cm

**Formula Used**

Volume of cylinder = πr²h

Volume of cone = (1/3)πr²h

**Calculation**

Volume of cone = Volume of cylinder

⇒ (1/3) π × 54² × h = π × 48² × 27

⇒ h = 64 cm.

∴ The height (in cm) of the pile = 64 cm
